title: Cylindrical rod (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system for the first part of the cylindrical rod by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees. Set the translation vector to zero point seven five, zero point zero zero five eight, and zero point zero zero five eight. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face by creating a single circle with a center at zero point zero zero seven three, zero point zero zero seven three, and a radius of zero point zero zero seven three. Scale this sketch by applying a scaling factor of zero point zero one four six. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the specified Euler angles and translating it using the specified translation vector. Extrude the sketch in the opposite direction of the normal by zero point seven five units to generate a solid body. The dimensions of the cylindrical rod are length zero point zero one four six two five units, width zero point zero one four six two five units, and height zero point seven five units.

For the second part, the cylindrical base with a spherical tip, create a new coordinate system with the same Euler angles as before and a translation vector of zero point seven five, zero, and zero. On the first face, draw two circles: the first circle has a center at zero point zero one three one, zero point zero one three one, and a radius of zero point zero one three one; the second circle has the same center but a radius of zero point zero zero seven three. On the second face, draw a single circle with the same center and radius as the second circle on the first face. Scale the entire sketch by applying a scaling factor of zero point zero two six two. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space using the specified Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch in the opposite direction of the normal by zero point zero zero one nine units to add material to the existing body. The dimensions of the cylindrical base with a spherical tip are length zero point zero two six two five units, width zero point zero two six two five units, and height zero point zero zero one eight seven five units. The final object combines both parts, forming a cylindrical rod with a spherical tip at one end and a cylindrical base at the other, maintaining symmetry along its length.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the first part (cylindrical rod)
cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0073, 0.0073)
    .circle(0.0073)
    .extrude(0.75)
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), -90)
    .translate((0.75, 0.0058, 0.0058))
)

# Create the second part (cylindrical base)
base = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0131, 0.0131)
    .circle(0.0131)
    .extrude(0.0019)
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), -90)
    .translate((0.75, 0.0, 0.0))
)

# Combine the two parts
r = cylinder.union(base)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the circle for the sketch
circle_center = (0.0131, 0.0131)
circle_radius = 0.0131

# Create the sketch on the XY plane
r = r.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
r = r.extrude(extrude_depth)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the cylinder 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Parameters
total_length = 0.75
head_diameter = 0.0262
shaft_diameter = 0.02
head_thickness = 0.008

# Shaft: long cylinder along X
shaft = cq.Workplane("YZ").circle(shaft_diameter / 2.0).extrude(total_length - head_thickness)

# Head: larger disc at the +X end
head = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .workplane(offset=total_length - head_thickness)
    .circle(head_diameter / 2.0)
    .extrude(head_thickness)
)

# Combine
r = shaft.union(head)
